summary: Reviewed 11 selected items against 4 eligible reserves. The set is topically diverse (security incident, practitioner story, first-party research, ICML keynote, agent-cost finding, open-source release, memory research, agent-loop breakdown, skeptic framing, Altman post, SaaS market analysis) with no true duplicates. Two sama posts exist across the pool but only one is selected, so no overrepresentation issue. The Altman 'clarity is nice' item is thin on standalone context but does not rise to a set-level failure. Count (11) sits at the top of the 6-11 target range. All items retained.
